title: Cross compiling godot games causes building platforms libraries to be included
body: ### Tested versions tested in 4.7 stable ### System information Godot Engine v4.7.stable.mono.arch_linux.5b4e0cb0f (2026-06-17 18:46:02 UTC) - https://godotengine.org ### Issue description when building a game from the command line on a machine that has a different operating system to the one targeting with addons that package for multiple systems (eg mac, windows, linux, freebsd ect) causes the building platforms libraries to be included instead of the target platform. this causes conflicts and makes godot mad about missing libraries in the included addon which in turn causes the build to fail. this is an image of my CI/CD pipeline failing with the error i've gottten with this issue. ### Steps to reproduce create a godot 4.7 project and download a addon that has native dependencies (eg, [imgui godot](https://github.com/pkdawson/imgui-godot) ) and target a platform that is not android or the current platform (eg mac -> windows, linux -> windows / mac) watch the build fail in the cli as it fails to build relating to some files not being found. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [mrptest.tar.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29645594/mrptest.tar.gz) i'm unable to get the MRP test to be under 10mb with github's supported file types.
